test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.**

The manager told him that she would ask him to leave the meeting if he continued to make negative remarks.

options.text: The manager told him, “You will ask me to leave the meeting if you continue to make negative remarks.”
The manager said to him, “I will ask you to leave the meeting if you continue to make negative remarks.”
The manager told him, “I will leave the meeting if you continue to make negative remarks.”
The manager asked him, “Will you leave the meeting if you continue to make negative remarks?”

solution:
The correct answer is: **The manager said to him, “I will ask you to leave the meeting if you continue to make negative remarks.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'told' changes to **'said to'** in the direct speech part.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The modal '**would**' in the indirect part changes to '**will**' in the direct speech part.
 
• The conditional '**if**' **remains the same** in the second clause because the sentence itself is giving a condition.
 
• The pronoun 'she' changes to 'I' and '**him**' changes to '**you**' in the direct speech part.
 
• Verb 3 '**continued**' changes to Verb 1 '**continue**' in the direct speech part.
 
 

Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *The manager said to him, “I will ask you to leave the meeting if you continue to make negative remarks."*
